title: The Silent Sigil Anew
author: Wren Eastwick
blurb: Mara Quintana, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
